notes.subject: ממקור
notes.rationale: 'Yumi kam long wara sors bilong Yisrael' (KJV, JPS) o 'givim blesing stat long wara sors bilong Yisrael' — narapela lain i tingting ol i tok blesing i stat long sors.

notes.subject: ברכו
notes.rationale: Ordar bilong olgeta man long kainkain: givim tok bilong blesing.

translation: Long ol bikpela kainkain bilong man i kamap wantaim, olkong givim tok bilong blesing long Elohim, long Yahwe, yu ol i kam long wara sors bilong Yisrael.

tokens.gloss: long ol bikpela kainkain bilong man i kamap wantaim
